Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: non-proliferation
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: No member may launch ballistic missiles at anyone while it holds. Needs InterRim Ballistic Missile.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifPassed: No member may launch missiles for 120 days: the AI of bound members stands down its silos, and any strike by a member is a breach.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifFailed: Members keep their missiles, and the doomsday clock keeps ticking.

Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: arms embargo
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: No member may arm the named faction while it is at war: its military strength wastes away, and its allies must step back from it.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifPassed: {0}'s military strength falls 8% at once and keeps wasting away; members allied to it must drop the alliance, and you must embargo it. Sending troops to its side is a breach.

Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: peacekeeping coalition
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: Members send forces to the side that was attacked until the aggressor stands down.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifPassed: The strongest willing members march warbands to {1}'s side; every day {1} gains war score and {0} grows wearier. If {0} is a member still at war after the grace period, it is in breach. You are asked to pay toward the force.

Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: war crimes tribunal
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: A tribunal judges an aggressor or a serial breaker of decrees: a fine paid to its victims, and disgrace.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifPassed: Every member thinks less of {0}; it loses legitimacy and stability, and must pay a fine to those it wronged. Not paying is a breach.

Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: recognition of conquest
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: The council recognises an occupier's hold on settlements it took: they become its own for good.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifPassed: Every settlement {0} occupies that belonged to {1} becomes {0}'s for good; {0} gains legitimacy and {1} resents the council.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifFailed: The settlements stay occupied, and {1} may still win them back.

Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: demand for liberation
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: The occupier must hand back occupied settlements to their owner within the grace period.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifPassed: {0} must return every settlement it holds of {1}'s within 15 days, or be in breach; while it holds them past the deadline its economy suffers 3%.

Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: admission of a member
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: Gives a faction below the technology threshold a seat at the council.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifPassed: {0} becomes a member for good: it attends, votes and is bound by decrees. It is grateful to the council.

Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: expulsion of a member
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: Suspends a repeat breaker of decrees: no seat, no vote and no protection while it holds.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifPassed: {0} loses its seat and vote for 90 days and its leader loses legitimacy. It is no longer protected by the council's decrees.

Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: choice of host
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: Names the member who hosts the next session.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifPassed: {0} hosts the next session, and its leader gains standing.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifFailed: The next host is chosen in the usual turn.

Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: relief fund
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: Members pay into a fund for a faction in crisis.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifPassed: {0} gains stability and a 4% economic boost at once; members with money to spare must pay into the fund within 10 days or be in breach (the poor and those in crisis are excused). You are asked for your share.

Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: free-trade zone
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: Low tariffs between members, and no embargoes among them.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifPassed: Members trade with each other on 8% better terms and their economies grow 3%; outsiders lose 1%. Keeping an embargo on another member (except sanctions) is a breach.

Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: debt relief
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: Forgives a faction's tribute: every tribute treaty it pays ends.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifPassed: Every tribute {0} pays is forgiven; {0} gains stability and a 3% economic boost. Creditors who keep collecting are in breach.

Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: common currency
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: A shared currency: steadier prices and a little more trade between members.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifPassed: For 180 days members trade on 3% better terms, their economies grow 2%, and economic shocks settle faster.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifFailed: Each member keeps its own money.

Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: plague quarantine
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: Members close their borders to a faction with plague, and the plague does not spread to them.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifPassed: Members must close their borders to {0} within 3 days, or be in breach; the plague cannot spread from {0} to members, and {0}'s economy loses 3% from the cut trade.

Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: refugee protection
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: Members share the burden when a faction's people flee: they take refugees in and must not shut them out.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifPassed: When a faction's people flee, members take some in (a little unrest, much gratitude) and you are asked for a contribution; a member with its border closed to them is in breach.

Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: ban on organ trade
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: No member harvests or sells organs.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifPassed: Harvesting organs is a breach for 150 days. Members whose ways allow it (cannibals, fleshcrafters, organ-use precepts) get caught now and then.

Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: ban on raiding
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: No member raids caravans, convoys or stores.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifPassed: Ambushing convoys, plundering stores or looting settlements is a breach for 120 days. Raiders and blood courts will hate it.

Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: cultural exchange
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: Members open to each other's culture: opinion warms, and your broadcasts reach further.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifPassed: For 90 days members slowly warm to each other and your culture spreads among them; closing a border to another member is a breach. Isolationists will oppose it.
